item.blurb: Agentcard Raises $8M Seed. Agentcard raises $8M in seed funding to enable AI agents to securely make online purchases for users through its specialized payment infrastructure.
Betterness Raises $1M Seed. Miami-based healthtech startup Betterness raises $1M in seed extension to scale its AI-powered neighborhood wellness network initiative.
Boston Medical Sciences Raises ¥5.55B Series B. Boston Medical Sciences raises 5.55 billion yen in a Series B round to advance its medical AI diagnostic technology for colorectal cancer.
Yoco Raises $100M Credit Facility. South African fintech Yoco secures a $100M credit facility  from Victory Park Capital to scale its merchant cash advance operations for small businesses.
StitchStudio Raises $8M Other. StitchStudio raises $8M in financing led by Voyager Capital to expand its AI automation platform for insurance underwriting and brokerage workflows.
